pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to a project directory that may contain a code indexing database and JavaScript source files.
post_condition: When the project's code analysis backend is available, returns a dict mapping each absolute filepath string to a list of (func_name: str, body_text: str) tuples — one tuple per function defined in that JavaScript source file — where body_text is the function's complete source code text. When the backend is unavailable for the project, returns an empty dict, indicating that no JavaScript functions were extracted through the backend.
